combos.why: unselected.enabled ← unchecked.enabled (from the declared base unchecked.enabled); unselected.disabled ← unchecked.disabled (from the declared base unchecked.enabled); selected.enabled ← checked.enabled (from the declared base unchecked.enabled); selected.disabled ← checked.disabled (from the declared base unchecked.enabled)

circle.why: round square 16px span.ant-radio-inner radius 50% whose paint changes unselected → selected

dot.why: pseudo ::after of span 16px transform matrix(0.375, 0, 0, 0.375, 0, 0) background-color rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) renders only in the selected combo

row.why: nearest common ancestor of circle and label: label display flex, align-items baseline, column-gap normal; label padding-left 8px

hit.why: no larger square parent; the circle is its own hit area

opacityOn.why: nothing dims when disabled; the circle carries opacity 1
